title: Rank, Don't Regress: A 279M Text Ranker Beats 2B and 7B VLMs on Referential Urdu GUI Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.20145v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: UI grounding asks a model to find the screen element that a user instruction refers to. Most current systems use a vision-language model (VLM) that reads a screenshot and outputs pixel coordinates. We study this task on Urdu mobile web pages, a setting with no published UI grounding results. Instead of regressing coordinates, we take the candidate elements from the page DOM and train a 279M-parameter cross-encoder (mDeBERTa-v3-base) to pick one. The click point is the centre of the picked element's box, so it is exact whenever the right element is picked. We built a frozen test set of 304 instructions from six Urdu news sites; 149 of them (49%) are referential and never quote the full target text. Test domains were banned from training data before collection started. The ranker scores 73.4% point-in-box accuracy, against 29.6% for UI-TARS-2B and 23.7% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both zero-shot. translated_title: 排序而非回归：一个279M参数的文本排序器在指代性乌尔都语GUI定位任务上击败2B和7B视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: UI定位要求模型找到用户指令所指向的屏幕元素。当前大多数系统使用视觉语言模型（VLM）读取截图并输出像素坐标。我们在乌尔都语移动网页上研究该任务，这是一个此前没有公开发表UI定位结果的场景。我们没有采用回归坐标的方式，而是从页面DOM中提取候选元素，训练一个279M参数的交叉编码器从中选出正确元素。点击点即为所选元素框的中心，因此只要选对元素，点击位置就是精确的。我们基于六个乌尔都语新闻网站构建了包含304条指令的冻结测试集，其中149条（49%）是指代性的，从不完整引用目标文本。测试域名在数据收集开始前就被排除在训练数据之外。该排序器取得73.4%的点在框内准确率，而零样本的UI-TARS-2B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B分别仅为29.6%和23.7%。在指代性子集上，该排序器取得65.8%的准确率。
tldr: 一个仅279M参数的文本排序器通过从页面DOM中排序选择元素而非回归坐标，在指代性乌尔都语GUI定位任务上以73.4%的准确率大幅超越零样本的2B和7B视觉语言模型。
